## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `9bfef5bb5329f8a65d7c1283f96bc9279283c544`
Local-runs: none
Scope: docs/adr/0066-unified-authorization-model.md + packages/spec/src/security/permission.zod.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/permission-evaluator.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-object-inputs.ts, packages/core/src/security/effective-object-permissions.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server/src/current-user-endpoints.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-field-readers.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-explain-access.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/explain-engine.ts, packages/lint/src/validate-rls-predicate-enforceability.ts (all read at the PR base, which the diff does not touch). The remainder (the four ui/packages/app-shell files, content/docs/permissions/field-level-security.mdx, the changeset) is the lane seat's ACCEPT at TIER_DEFAULT.

Inputs: card #25866 body and all nine comments (ruling 6408558941, premise check 6409890004, claim 6410022810, reports 6411406490 / 6411685596 / 6412756598, seat note 6412200901); PR #26010 body, file list (7 paths) and the net diff of `3518664c...9bfef5bb` via the compare API; the 63 check-runs on `9bfef5bb` (33 success, 6 skipped by path, 0 failure, 0 pending). No PR reviews or PR comments exist at review time.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **The ADR hunk is one sentence, and the rewrite is right.** Old: "The muting/deny layer ⑦ still owes remains the mechanism for taking an edit away that another set grants." New: "Taking an edit away that another set grants remains the job of the muting/deny layer ⑦ still owes." Same claim, grammatical. The claim holds against the code at this head: `PermissionEvaluator.getFieldPermissions` (permission-evaluator.ts, the loop after `fieldPermissionVote`) sets `editable = true` on any vote that carries it and never clears it, so a sibling's unconditioned `editable: true` out-votes a matched conditioned lock; ADR-0066 precedence step 4 and bullet ⑦ still name the deny layer as deferred. Right.
2. **The rest of the ⑧ note stays true at this head, clause by clause.** (a) `FieldPermissionSchema.when` is an optional non-blank string with a refine refusing it beside `readable: false` (permission.zod.ts, `FIELD_PERMISSION_WHEN_ON_READABLE`, path `when`) — edit vote only, refused at parse: right. (b) The write gate: `computeForbiddenFieldWrites` (security-plugin-object-inputs.ts) judges an insert on each incoming payload row and a by-id update on the caller-read pre-image, compiling each distinct `when` once through `rlsCompiler.compileRowPredicate` and judging it with `storedFormCheckJudge([filter], columns)`, in process — right. (c) A row that cannot be judged: a null pre-image, a predicate update, a condition that yields no filter, or a judge that throws all return `unjudged`, and `fieldPermissionVote` (effective-object-permissions.ts) gives `unjudged` its read bit as declared and NO edit grant — the lock: right. (d) The row-blind readers: `/auth/me/permissions` merges through `buildEffectiveFieldPermissions` (current-user-endpoints.ts:909, row-blind by construction); the writable-field projection (security-plugin-field-readers.ts:188/212) and `os explain` (`getFieldMask` / `getPartialMaskRules` in security-plugin-explain-access.ts) call `getFieldPermissions` with no judge, so every conditioned entry is `unjudged` there, and the explain fls layer additionally names each conditioned entry (explain-engine.ts, `conditionedFieldEntries`): "no reading is wider than the gate's" is right. (e) Authoring validation: `validateRlsPredicateEnforceability` judges `permissions[].fields[key].when` as clause `'when'` against the key's object head, under the `rls-predicate-*` ids: right.
3. **No published-surface change.** The diff touches no `packages/spec` path, no json-schema, no generated artefact; the accept-set at the spec door is exactly what #25980 landed. `Metadata-protocol: none` is right. The `FieldPerm.when` field added in `ui/packages/app-shell/.../permission-slice.ts` is the Studio's draft view-model; it is not re-exported from the package index (grep at base: no hit), so it widens no public API of `@object-ui/app-shell`. Right.
4. **The Studio never authors the shape the spec refuses (TIER_DEFAULT remainder, named so the ADR claim and its only new producer are read together).** `updateFieldPerm` deletes `when` on the Read-off cascade; `updateFieldWhen` sets `readable = true` when a non-blank condition is typed on a Read-off entry and deletes the key on blank text; `withFieldBits` carries an existing `when` only beside `readable: true` (both bulk arms pass `true`). The published refine is therefore never reached by a Studio draft, and no runtime gate is widened. Right.
5. **The Studio lint is a subset of the publish gate, as the docs sentence says.** `rlsPredicateVerdict` (celAuthoring.ts) lints the text as a one-clause `check` stack with no object, exactly as the RLS clauses are linted in Studio; parse faults and unresolvable `current_user.*` variables hold the save, unknown-field findings are left to the publish gate, which judges the `when` clause with its object. "linted the same way as the RLS clauses" (mdx, changeset, PR body) is right, and the publish gate stays the gate of record.
6. **The checks tab's red belongs to another head.** The check-runs on `9bfef5bb` include `Check Changeset` success (completed 09:03:04Z) alongside Governed Surface Queue Guard, Lint & Repo Gates, every Test Core and Test UI shard, Type Check UI, Build & E2E UI and Build Docs, all success. Nothing on this head is red or pending. Right.
7. **The branch's merge commit adds no content.** The compare API diff `3518664c...9bfef5bb` lists exactly the seven files of the PR file list (+416/−32); the history merge in 51f22e27 carries nothing beyond main plus the patch round, as the report claims. Right.

### ② Semver level

Changeset `.changeset/25866-studio-field-permission-when.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell: patch`, body carries `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: none` on their own lines; the PR body carries the same two lines plus `Ruling-ref: 6408558941`. `@object-ui/app-shell` is a member of the root fixed group (`.changeset/config.json`), so the patch bumps the group as a whole, which is the only level a non-protocol widening may take. The merged `.changeset/25866-field-permission-row-condition.md` of #25980 is not in the diff (check-changeset-overwrite respected). Check Changeset on this head is success. Level matches what the diff publishes: a Studio authoring control for an already-published key, no schema, no runtime gate.

Clause-②: yes (widening) — right; the diff adds an authoring affordance and narrows nothing.

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev flags (os-dev-report 6412756598):
- "Tier H: ADR-0066 touched — contract review + maintainer approval owed." Answered: this record is the contract review; docs/adr/** is a Tier H register row, so landing still needs an approving review from a `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` account (os-zhuang or hotlong) on this head, and no seat arms or queues it before that. Escalated to the maintainer by this record's existence, nothing more.
- "PR body carries Part of #25866, no closing keyword; the card reopened and stays pm:dispatched." Answered: the guard `Part-of PR must not also close its card` is success on this head; the card's close is the seat's hand act after landing, as 6412200901 states.
- "one stale red on the PR's checks tab belongs to #25980's merged head." Answered in ①.6: the check-runs on `9bfef5bb` carry no failure; the red run was on `3d377586`.
- "no GitHub MCP writes; every write through the relay." Answered: not re-measurable from here; the report's accounting is internally consistent (11 relay writes, 0 MCP writes), no contrary evidence on the PR or card.

open_questions:
1. Lint wording says CHECK, not WHEN. Answered: no contract point. The Studio lint is the same one-clause stack every RLS clause gets, and the publish gate's `when` clause carries its own `WHEN_DROPPED` cost sentence; a dedicated `when` clause in `celAuthoring.ts` is a cosmetic follow-up the ui lane may file, not a condition on this PR.
2. Read off clears an authored condition with no undo. Answered: acceptable for the draft form. The cascade is the only way the form never authors `when` beside `readable: false`, the cell shows the reason (`perm.field.when.readOff`), and the draft is autosaved, so the cost is retyping one predicate. A confirm step is a ui-lane follow-up, not owed here.
3. The merge commit in the branch history. Answered: the net diff against main is the seven files (①.7); a squash merge collapses it. No action required; the maintainer may ask for a linear branch at landing time.

No premise of ruling 6408558941 is touched by this PR; ① (Studio form offers the key) is delivered by the remainder, which is the lane seat's ACCEPT at TIER_DEFAULT.

## 席位核对

ACCEPT · domain:spec seat 2 · 2026-10-26T09:40Z · head `9bfef5bb5329f8a65d7c1283f96bc9279283c544`

1. **Shape.** Draft, base `main`, `Part of #25866` (no closing keyword: the card was reopened for this remainder, comment 6412200901). 7 files, +416/−32; the compare diff is exactly these 7 files, so the merge commit in the history adds nothing.
2. **Governed.** `check-governed-merges --pr 26010`: GOVERNED, Tier H, on one path, `docs/adr/0066-unified-authorization-model.md`. No seat flips this PR ready, enqueues it or arms auto-merge.
3. **Gates (check-runs pinned to this head).** 0 failed, 6 skipped. `check-expected-skips --pr 26010`: OK. The red `Check Changeset` on the checks tab ran on `3d377586` (#25980's merged head), not on this head.
4. **Contract review.** PASS at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` on this head, comment 6412858617 (face `rules`, scope the ADR-0066 ⑧ hunk and the code it cites). The rewritten sentence makes the same claim, and the rest of the ⑧ note stays true at this head.
5. **Remainder at `TIER_DEFAULT` (seat-read).** `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx`, `permission-slice.ts`, `i18n.ts` and the new 6-test file. The Studio never authors the refused shape: the Read-off cascade deletes `when`, typing a condition switches Read on, and `withFieldBits` keeps `when` only beside `readable: true`. Save is held while a field condition has an error-severity finding. `FieldPerm` is app-shell's internal view model, not a published surface. `@object-ui/app-shell` patch with `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: none` matches.
6. **Prose checked against the diff.**
   - Changeset: "Read off clears the condition, Read all / Write all keep it, Clear drops the entry, blank text removes the key": each matches the handlers. "a finding the publish gate would refuse holds the save": the hold counts error-severity lint findings, which is the gate's refusal set for this clause.
   - `field-level-security.mdx` "In Studio" bullet: matches the same handlers.
7. **Open questions (os-dev-report 6412756598).**
   - Q1, CHECK vs WHEN wording in the Studio lint: cosmetic, not a contract point. Stays as is.
   - Q2, Read off clears a condition with no undo: accepted. The form is a draft with autosave and the condition can be retyped; a confirm step is not owed.
   - Q3, the merge commit in history: accepted; a squash merge collapses it.
8. **Landing.** Waits for an APPROVED review on this head from a GOVERNED_APPROVERS account (os-zhuang or hotlong). After it lands, card #25866 is closed by hand (the PR carries `Part of`).

Seat 2 · landing after an authorized approval: os-zhuang APPROVED (review 5653843747) on head `9bfef5bb`. Pre-landing checks on this head: `check-governed-merges` GOVERNED Tier H, approval present; `check-expected-skips` OK (6 skipped, all in main's roster); every check-run complete with 0 failures. The ACCEPT (6412880222) and contract review PASS (6412858617) stand. Auto-merge armed.
